{"predictors": [
  {"name": "Inventory Growth Rate", "construction": "Year-over-year percentage change in inventories (from Compustat annual data: INVT) divided by prior-year total assets (AT).", "rationale": "Firms aggressively building inventories may be overestimating future demand, leading to subsequent corrections.", "higher_returns_for": "low values of the measure"},
  {"name": "Short-Term Debt Surge", "construction": "Current year increase in short-term debt (DLC) scaled by total assets (AT), using Compustat annual data.", "rationale": "A surge in short-term borrowing may signal liquidity stress or poor credit conditions.", "higher_returns_for": "low values of the measure"},
  {"name": "Non-Operating Income Share", "construction": "Non-operating income (OIBDP - OIADP) divided by total revenues (REVT), using Compustat annual data.", "rationale": "A high reliance on non-core activities may indicate lower earnings quality and higher risk.", "higher_returns_for": "low values of the measure"},
  {"name": "Past Insider Buying", "construction": "Net shares bought by insiders (Form 4 SEC filings), aggregated over the prior 12 months and scaled by shares outstanding.", "rationale": "Insider buying may reflect superior information regarding undervaluation or positive future prospects.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"},
  {"name": "Dividend Omission Indicator", "construction": "Indicator variable equal to 1 if a firm paid dividends two years ago but omitted dividends in the most recent fiscal year (from CRSP/Compustat).", "rationale": "Omitting a dividend may signal financial distress or deteriorating fundamentals.", "higher_returns_for": "firms without recent omissions (i.e., a value of 0)"},
  {"name": "Seasonal Sales Momentum", "construction": "Current quarter sales (SALEQ) minus sales from the same quarter last year, scaled by prior-year quarterly sales (Compustat quarterly data).", "rationale": "Unexpected improvement in seasonal sales may indicate underestimated growth potential.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"},
  {"name": "R&D Expense Growth", "construction": "Year-over-year percentage change in R&D expense (XRD) divided by prior-year total assets (AT), using Compustat annual data.", "rationale": "Accelerating investment in R&D may signal innovation and future profitability.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"},
  {"name": "Dividend Payout Volatility", "construction": "Standard deviation of annual dividend per share (DPS, CRSP) over the past five years divided by mean DPS.", "rationale": "High dividend volatility may indicate unstable earnings or weak governance.", "higher_returns_for": "low values of the measure"},
  {"name": "Cash Acquisition Ratio", "construction": "Cash used for acquisitions (from Statement of Cash Flows, Compustat CHEQ outflows for acquisitions) divided by total assets (AT), over trailing three years.", "rationale": "Aggressive acquisition activity may lead to post-merger integration risk and lower returns.", "higher_returns_for": "low values of the measure"},
  {"name": "Employee Growth Rate", "construction": "Year-over-year percentage change in number of employees (EMP, Compustat annual data), divided by prior-year employees.", "rationale": "Rapid hiring may reflect overexpansion or management optimism that outpaces market reality.", "higher_returns_for": "low values of the measure"}
]}
